posts.title: My one-word LLM call was thinking behind my back
posts.description: On my triage calls, a default thinking setting I never turned on raised the estimated cost by 52% and the median response time by about 0.6 seconds. I only noticed because token counts were on the trace. This is how I found it, and the one request field that turns it off.

posts.title: Element-scoped View Transitions
posts.description: Document view transitions freeze the whole page while they run. Element-scoped view transitions in Chrome 147 keep the rest of the page interactive. Here is how they work and how to build a list that stays clickable.

posts.title: We moved off Firestore. The slow page stayed slow.
posts.description: Two days after our internal resume platform moved from Firestore to Firebase SQL Connect, the page that pushed us into it was still downloading 18 MB and locking up for a minute. The new database made a better query possible. Writing that query is what made the page fast.
